It includes an onboard generator, an industrial air compressor, an arc welder, and an extensive suite of pneumatic and hand tools. It enables wheeled vehicle mechanics (MOS 91B) to diagnose, service, and repair disabled vehicles directly on the battlefield.

NAME: AN/PSN-13 Defense Advanced GPS Receiver (DAGR)
DESCRIPTION: This is a handheld, dual-frequency military satellite navigation receiver that tracks encrypted military P(Y)-code GPS signals. It provides dismounted soldiers and vehicular platforms with precise position, speed, and timing information resistant to enemy electronic jamming and spoofing. The unit can be integrated with tactical radios, laser rangefinders, and command computers to transmit instant situational reports.

NAME: Unit Armorer Small Arms Tool Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is a standardized tool set issued to unit armorers to conduct organizational-level maintenance on assigned small arms. It includes specialized cleaning rods, armorer's multi-tools, alignment gages, pin punches, and screwdrivers tailored for M4 carbines, M17 pistols, and M240 machine guns. The kit ensures weapons remain functional and compliant with technical manuals at the company level.

NAME: M1076 Palletized Load System Trailer (PLST)
DESCRIPTION: This is a three-axle tactical trailer engineered to carry standard 8x20 foot flatracks or 20-foot ISO shipping containers with a payload capacity of 16.5 tons. It is towed behind M1074 or M1075 Palletized Load System (PLS) trucks, effectively doubling the cargo capacity of a single vehicle and crew. The trailer features a self-steering rear axle and air suspension to maintain stability and maneuverability over rough cross-country terrain.

NAME: AN/PRC-117G Multiband Manpack Radio
DESCRIPTION: This is an advanced tactical software-defined manpack radio covering high-frequency (HF), very-high-frequency (VHF), and ultra-high-frequency (UHF) bands from 30 MHz to 2 GHz. It provides secure Type 1 encrypted line-of-sight voice, dedicated tactical satellite communications (TACSAT), and high-speed Mobile User Objective System (MUOS) mobile data. Powered by rechargeable lithium-ion batteries, it is widely utilized by infantry, special operations, and forward air controllers.

NAME: Shop Equipment, Welding Field Repair
DESCRIPTION: This is a complete mobile welding and metal-cutting equipment set mounted on a heavy-duty trailer or packaged in modular containers. It includes a multi-process engine-driven welder/generator, oxyacetylene cutting torches, safety gear, and specialized electrodes for welding high-strength steel and aluminum armor. It allows field mechanics to perform critical structural and battle-damage repairs directly on combat platforms.

NAME: Special Sniper Rifle Equipment and Accessory Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is an operational equipment and maintenance kit tailored to support precision sniper weapon systems such as the M110 Semi-Automatic Sniper System or M2010 Enhanced Sniper Rifle. It contains precision optical cleaning gear, bore guides, specialized torque wrenches, anti-reflection devices, and night-vision optical couplers. The kit ensures sniper teams can maintain match-grade accuracy and weapon readiness under expeditionary field conditions.

NAME: M915A5 Line-Haul Truck Tractor
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial-derivative 6x4 heavy tactical truck tractor designed to pull semitrailers such as the M872 34-ton flatbed and M967 fuel tankers over highway and primary road networks. Powered by an inline 6-cylinder turbocharged diesel engine generating over 500 horsepower, it can haul gross combination weights up to 120,000 pounds. The modern A5 model features an armored cab option (B-kit), enhanced suspension, and advanced vehicle stability control.

NAME: Shop Equipment, Guided Missile Maintenance
DESCRIPTION: This is a specialized mobile maintenance shop set containing diagnostic test consoles, optical collimators, and armorer tools for servicing anti-tank guided missile systems (such as TOW and Javelin). It allows technicians to verify missile launcher electronics, sight sensor alignments, and fire control interfaces. The set is packaged in ruggedized shipping containers for tactical deployment.

NAME: M1151A1 Armament Carrier HMMWV
DESCRIPTION: This is an expanded-capacity 4x4 light tactical vehicle configured with Integrated Armor Protection (IAP) to protect the crew against small arms, artillery shrapnel, and blast hazards. It features a reinforced roof weapon station equipped with an armored gunner shield to mount weapon systems including the M2A1 .50 cal, MK19 grenade launcher, or M240B machine gun. It carries a four-soldier combat crew plus ammunition and gear over challenging cross-country terrain.

NAME: M500 12-Gauge Shotgun
DESCRIPTION: This is a pump-action tactical 12-gauge shotgun manufactured by Mossberg, featuring an 18.5-inch barrel, a 5-round tubular magazine, and an ambidextrous safety switch. It is employed by military police, security elements, and infantry for close-quarters room clearing, security operations, and mechanical door breaching using specialized frangible rounds. The weapon fires standard 2-3/4 inch and 3-inch shotshells, including buckshot, solid slugs, and non-lethal munitions.

NAME: TS-3895A/UV Night Vision Test Set
DESCRIPTION: This is an optical and electrical test station designed to test, focus, calibrate, and evaluate Aviator's Night Vision Imaging Systems (such as AN/AVS-6 and AN/AVS-9). It incorporates high-precision optical collimators and calibrated light targets to verify binocular alignment, infinity focus, and image intensifier tube resolution. It is used in aviation life support and electronics maintenance shops to guarantee pilot safety.

NAME: AN/USM-491 Radio Frequency Test Set
DESCRIPTION: This is a comprehensive radio frequency test and alignment station used by depot and direct support electronic repair facilities. It provides calibrated RF signal generation, spectrum analysis, and power measurement across military communication and radar bands. The unit is utilized to align complex communications transceivers and microwave radio repeaters.

NAME: M1089A1 5-Ton Wrecker Truck
DESCRIPTION: This is a 6x6 tactical wrecker vehicle built on the Family of Medium Tactical Vehicles (FMTV) chassis, designed to perform vehicle recovery and towing missions. It is equipped with a 5-ton capacity hydraulic recovery crane, twin 11,000-pound recovery winches, and an underlift towing system capable of lifting and towing disabled trucks. It allows recovery teams to upright overturned vehicles and tow them to forward maintenance points.

NAME: M1101 1-1/4 Ton High Mobility Cargo Trailer
DESCRIPTION: This is a single-axle, all-aluminum light cargo trailer designed to be towed behind HMMWVs and other light tactical vehicles over all terrain types. It has a payload rating of 2,500 pounds and shares the same track width, ground clearance, and run-flat tires as its prime mover to ensure off-road mobility. The trailer features a weather-resistant cargo cover and a tailgate for easy manual loading.
